# About TechTide Corporate LLP

TechTide Corporate LLP is a technology company providing software development, web development, mobile application development, business automation, and AI-powered digital solutions.

The company works with startups, SMEs, and enterprises to design and develop scalable software systems that solve operational challenges and create growth opportunities.

## Services

* Custom Software Development
* SaaS Product Development
* Web Development
* Mobile App Development
* CRM Development
* ERP Development
* API Integration
* Business Automation
* Growth Marketing Systems
* AI Development

## Technologies

React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Flutter, React Native, AWS, Docker, Firebase, OpenAI APIs.

## Industries

Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Finance, E-commerce, Logistics, Manufacturing, and Technology Startups.

## Mission

To help businesses transform ideas into scalable digital products that improve efficiency, customer experience, and growth.
